title: checklist: v18.5.0 sweep close-out, batch A: item-text re-points in `records-forms.json`
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Carries the batch-A item-text re-points of #33761 (the v18.5.0 release test sweep anchor); #33761 keeps the other batches, the runner kit and the coverage card. Filing gate ①: the follow-up owed by in-flight work. The anchor's step-1 ledger (comment 6896511848, read at `origin/main` `895783a1`) has 138 item-text re-point rows over about 104 items, too many for one PR; the seat split them by area-file family, one card per family with no shared file (the #32908 precedent, split comment 6881136418). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope

- Files: `records-forms.json` under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` (and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json` only if a gate regenerates it).
- Rows of ledger 6896511848 (disposition `item-text re-point`, 21 items): 9 13 14 126 128 131 133 135 137 140 141 142 143 144 146 148 149 150 151 153 200 219 220 221 222 224
- Rows repeated across rounds are one edit each. Every row is re-read at `origin/main` first; the edit starts from the measured residue, not the parked text.
- Each edited item: `revision` +1 and one `history` row (ref = the PR number). The area JSON is not canonical `JSON.stringify`: edit text spans, never re-serialise.
- ⛔ No product package, no `ui/**`, no `scripts/qa/**`, no `RUNNER.md` (the runner-kit card carries those). ⛔ Not the items #33859, #33860 and #33842 carry.

## Acceptance

- Every row above is edited or answered on the PR with a reading (already right at the PR's base, or moved to another carrier).
- `check:platform-checklist` and the derived gate families pass.

Priority p1, inherited from #33761 (release acceptance evidence).
